pieces.Text: Your morale bonus from get 'em increases to +2. As a standard action, you can make a single attack against a target within 60 feet. You and your allies within 60 feet gain the benefits of get 'em against that target (applying these effects before making the attack roll). As with get 'em, you can spend 1 Resolve Point to grant the benefits against all enemies within 60 feet. You must have the get 'em envoy improvisation to choose this improvisation.
